description: This file provides Romanian translations for Select2 version 4.0.6-rc.1, a jQuery-based replacement for select boxes, including error messages and prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a prompt asking the user to delete a number of characters if input exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a prompt asking the user to input more characters if input length is below the minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed during a search operation.
